item.title: Sawachi: Kochi's Grand Feasting Platter — Guide
item.description: Sawachi ryori is the grand banquet cuisine of Kochi, the essence of Tosa’s famously open-hearted, hard-drinking hospitality. A single enormous platter, often half a metre or more across, is heaped with an abundant assortment of dishes — sashimi, sushi, katsuo tataki, tempura, simmered items, and sweets all together — and set in the middle of the table for everyone to share freely. The style reflects the Tosa character: generous, unpretentious and sociable, meant to keep the sake flowing and the conversation lively for hours.
